study_label: GPT-OSS-120B human-first controlled-edit candidate reranking pilot

returned_candidates.candidate_structure_serialization: CSV order; case_id NUL candidate_slot NUL remote_candidate_id NUL source_text_sha256 NUL candidate_text_sha256 LF

local_alias.formula: sha256(utf8(namespace + NUL + remote_candidate_id + NUL + case_id + NUL + decimal_candidate_slot))
local_alias.remote_alias_serialization: CSV order; remote_candidate_id NUL local_candidate_alias LF

scoring.sentence_set: All 60 exact originals and all 180 exact returned candidates
scoring.coverage_gate: Exactly one finite in-range score per score_id for all 240 rows under SpeciTeller and native GranuScore and all 120 corpus rows under each Ko run; identities and hashes must match; no retraining or substitution.
scoring.timing: Scoring begins only after this config and its freeze record are committed; scores cannot affect inclusion, review side, or row order.

automatic_proxy_audit.timing: After the exact 180-row returned set is imported; audit only.

selection_policies.rule: For add_specific select the greatest aligned candidate-minus-original delta; for de_specify select the smallest aligned delta; for irrelevant_rewrite select the smallest absolute aligned delta. Ties select the lowest candidate slot.
selection_policies.ko_mean_rule: Convert each saved Ko score string to Decimal, add the three values, divide by Decimal(3), then convert only the final value for downstream numeric use.
selection_policies.consensus_rule: Within source and direction, order slots independently under SpeciTeller, Ko run01, run02, run03, and aligned GranuScore using the same direction rule with lowest-slot tie resolution; assign ranks 1..3, sum ranks, and select lowest sum then lowest slot.

blinding.review_id: DHF- plus first 12 RFC4648 base32 characters without padding of sha256(seed:namespace:local_candidate_alias)
blinding.side_assignment: Within each hidden corpus-by-direction cell, sort by sha256(seed:local_candidate_alias); candidate is A for the first exact half and B for the second, yielding 50/50 in every cell and 90/90 overall.
blinding.row_order: Sort all packet rows by sha256(seed:review_id).

score_values.X: no usable comparison because meaning/factuality/grammar is not acceptably preserved

blinding.freshness: All review-ID, side, and order seeds and namespaces differ from the prior Gemma packet.

outputs.privacy: Text-bearing candidates, scoring inputs/outputs, key, mappings, and review packet remain ignored. Track only content-free counts, hashes, method records, tests, and handoffs.

stop_conditions: any archive, member, source, candidate, alias, provenance, run, model, config, freeze, scorer, or checkpoint binding differs
coverage is not exactly 60 sources, 180 candidates, three slots per source, and 240 scorer rows
any primary score is missing, duplicated, nonfinite, or out of native range
any proxy or score affects inclusion or reviewer presentation
packet count, bijection, side balance, CSV/XLSX equality, privacy, validation, or rendering fails
a scientific rule would need to change after scorer outcomes
